text: {"lessons":["Locking in gains on Stock B, C, and E felt satisfying, but a gain relative to my average cost does not tell me whether selling is the best choice now.","My account value still fluctuated after those sales, so I should keep risk and diversification in mind rather than assume a few trades will smooth returns.","Past price changes do not predict future prices; I should avoid frequent trading based on short-term moves and make decisions with a consistent plan."]}
